description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Home! * Two Master Suites and Two Living Areas* Covered, Vaulted Deck with Oyster Shell Fireplace* Eastern Lake Nearby* 5 BIKES Included* Small Elegant Community w/ Infinity Pool * Community Grill and Pool Tower w/ Sitting Area * Nearby Greenway Station - NEW Summer 2023!* Nearby Café 30A, Old Florida Fish House, and The Perfect Pig * Only 2.5 miles from Seaside* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service **This property does not allow parties of adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions.** *Due to an HOA restriction, a 7nt minimum stay is required from March 1 - October 31. Max occupancy is limited to 10 and strictly enforced. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!**Parking at the home will fit 2 vehicles in the designated driveway. Any cars illegally parked will be towed by the HOA.** **Please note there’s construction nearby, but rest assured it won’t interrupt your stay or the peaceful enjoyment of your time here.**From the moment you arrive at Stay Salty, you will start a new vacation tradition of a lifetime! This 2500sqft, home is just off Hwy 30A in Seagrove Beach. Located only 2.5 miles from Seaside, you are right in the heart of all things 30A. Stay Salty features 4 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and sleeps up to 10 guests comfortably. The first floor centers around a living room and has a queen bedroom, a bedroom with 2 sets of twin bunk beds, and a queen master bedroom that features an en suite bath with a walk-in shower. The main living area on the second floor has a spectacular modern design featuring walnut hardwood floors, a Chef’s kitchen with Viking appliances, unique lighting, rock flooring in the bathrooms, and a spacious living room with 12-foot ceilings accented with custom beams. Step outside onto the huge covered, vaulted deck off the 2nd-floor living room that boasts a fabulous oyster shell finished fireplace! On the third floor, you will find a loft area with a balcony that features views of the Gulf, and a King Master bedroom with a walk-in shower and garden tub. Come see why guests vacation at Stay Salty year after year! SeaNest Village is an exclusive, gated community in beautiful Seagrove Beach on Hwy 30A! This luxury neighborhood is low density with only 43 home sites and features a large community pool deck. This infinity edge, modern pool design is 2 tiered with a waterfall! The pool deck also has a community grill and tower sitting area for taking in the Gulf breezes. Hungry? Many fabulous area restaurants such as Cafe 30a, Angelina's, The Perfect Pig Gourmet Market, and Old Florida Fish House are nearby. Backing up to Point Washington State Forest, SeaNest Village will provide the luxury and privacy for a perfect beach vacation! The Bed Setup: 1st Floor: Master Bedroom: Queen Bed w/ ensuite bathGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: 2 Twin Bunk Beds 3rd Floor: Master Bedroom: King Bed w/ ensuite bathArea Attractions: Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous.30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.Greenway station is 30A's newest destination for gathering, shopping, and dining in Seagrove Beach. Greenway Station features known retailers Wild Olives Tapas and Wine Bar, Pecan Jack's Ice Cream, Coast Hippie and YOLO Board + Bike, plus introduces Local Cantina Mexican Restaurant, Souper Jenny Coffee Roasters, Canopy Road Café, and more.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
